desktop_tray_meters_stacked: CPU and memory on two lines
desktop_setup_text: Choose the components and launcher keys to use.
desktop_shortcut_failed: This shortcut cannot be registered. Choose another key.
desktop_icon_too_large: The image is too large. Choose a file of 512 KB or less.
desktop_icon_failed: The image cannot be loaded. Choose another file.
desktop_component_shell_tip: Runs the dock, top bar, launcher, panel and notification center on the Windows desktop.
desktop_component_files_tip: Turns on the Atrix file explorer with tabs and previews.
desktop_component_terminal_tip: Turns on the Atrix terminal for command-line work.
desktop_autostart_tip: Starts Atrix when you sign in to Windows.
desktop_component_agent_tip: Turns on AI features such as coding agent sessions, the knowledge graph and device pairing.
desktop_component_agent_required_tip: Atrix AI is always required on this operating system.
desktop_component_keep_one_tip: Keep either the desktop shell or Atrix AI on.
desktop_last_entry_tip: Keep either the dock or the launcher on.
desktop_dock_enabled_tip: Shows the dock with your apps and windows along a screen edge.
desktop_dock_style_tip: Chooses between a full-width taskbar and a floating dock.
desktop_dock_edge_tip: Chooses the screen edge the dock sits on.
desktop_dock_monitor_tip: Chooses the display for the dock and top bar.
desktop_dock_behind_tip: Keeps the dock behind windows so they can cover it.
desktop_dock_height_tip: Changes the height of the dock.
desktop_dock_icon_size_tip: Changes the size of app icons in the dock.
desktop_dock_width_tip: Changes the base width of the floating dock.
desktop_dock_growth_tip: Widens the dock when many windows are open and gathers the rest into an overflow menu.
desktop_dock_autohide_tip: Hides the dock until the pointer reaches the screen edge.
desktop_dock_hide_delay_tip: Changes how long the dock waits before hiding after the pointer leaves.
desktop_dock_hide_animation_tip: Slides the dock toward the edge before it hides.
desktop_dock_edge_only_tip: Reveals the hidden dock only when the pointer touches the screen edge.
desktop_dock_fullscreen_tip: Reveals the dock over full-screen windows when the pointer reaches the edge.
desktop_dock_islands_tip: Splits the dock into rounded islands.
desktop_dock_launcher_button_tip: Shows a button in the dock that opens the launcher.
desktop_dock_icon_tip: Chooses the image on the launcher button in the dock.
desktop_edit_layout_tip: Changes the order and spacing of widgets in the dock and top bar.
desktop_hide_taskbar_tip: Hides the Windows taskbar while Atrix DE runs.
desktop_topbar_enabled_tip: Moves the clock, tray and widgets to a separate bar at the top of the screen.
desktop_panel_position_tip: Chooses where the calendar panel opens when you select the clock.
desktop_launcher_enabled_tip: Turns on the launcher for finding and running apps, windows and commands.
desktop_launcher_trigger_tip: Chooses the key that opens the launcher.
desktop_launcher_shortcut_tip: Changes the key combination that opens the launcher.
desktop_launcher_windows_tip: Includes open windows in the results.
desktop_launcher_commands_tip: Includes system commands such as lock, sleep and empty Recycle Bin.
desktop_launcher_todos_tip: Lets you add todos straight from the search field.
desktop_launcher_calculator_tip: Calculates expressions as you type them.
desktop_launcher_web_tip: Chooses the search engine for web results.
desktop_launcher_results_tip: Changes how many items each result group shows.
desktop_launcher_keymap_tip: Shows shortcut keys in the launcher footer and result rows.
desktop_launcher_terminal_tip: Chooses the app that the Terminal command in the launcher opens.
desktop_tray_icons_tip: Shows notification area icons from background programs.
desktop_tray_volume_tip: Shows the volume icon, which changes the volume as you scroll over it.
desktop_tray_battery_tip: Shows the battery level on devices with a battery.
desktop_tray_network_tip: Shows the Wi-Fi or Ethernet connection status.
desktop_tray_bluetooth_tip: Shows Bluetooth status and connected devices.
desktop_tray_input_tip: Shows the input language of the active window when you have more than one keyboard layout.
desktop_tray_meters_tip: Shows live CPU and memory usage.
desktop_tray_meters_stacked_tip: Shows CPU and memory usage on two lines.
desktop_tray_notifications_tip: Shows a button that opens the notification center.
desktop_tray_taskview_tip: Shows a button that opens Windows Task View.
desktop_tray_desktop_tip: Shows a button that minimizes every window to reveal the desktop.
desktop_tray_settings_tip: Shows a button that opens Atrix DE settings.
desktop_clock_align_tip: Chooses how the time and date line up inside the clock.
desktop_media_enabled_tip: Shows play, pause and skip controls for the media that is playing.
desktop_media_spectrum_tip: Shows the live output level beside the media controls.
desktop_media_spectrum_style_tip: Chooses how the sound spectrum is drawn.
desktop_claude_enabled_tip: Shows usage of the five-hour and weekly Claude limits.
desktop_claude_stacked_tip: Shows the five-hour and weekly limits on two lines.
desktop_claude_bridge_tip: Reads usage from the Claude Code status line.
desktop_claude_file_tip: Sets the file path or URL to read usage from.
